items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: Buck was a very close friend to me.

ctx.x: Oh. Well, of course, everybody thinks it's Buck that played pretty all the time.
Well, yeah, that was me. I took a lot of solos, you know, that Buck got the credit for. Like "Every Tub", "Sent for You Yesterday."
